title: AI integration: How to bring AI into your workflows
summary: Here's what AI integration really means, how real teams are putting it to use, along with a step-by-step approach to bringing AI into your workflows.

**Native AI features**


You use the AI already built into apps you pay for


Quick wins with zero setup


Gmail drafting email replies; Notion summarizing meeting notes


**Workflow AI integration**


An[automation platform](https://zapier.com/blog/best-automation-software/) connects AI models to your apps, so AI-powered steps run inside automated workflows


Repeatable, cross-app processes that need to run at scale


A new support ticket kicks off a workflow in Zapier that summarizes, prioritizes, and routes it


**AI assistant integration**


Your[AI assistant](https://zapier.com/blog/ai-personal-assistant/) connects to your apps, so it can pull data and take action from the chat window


Ad hoc requests that don't follow a fixed process


Asking ChatGPT to pull this week's deals from your CRM and draft follow-ups using MCP


**Custom AI integration**


Your team builds directly against model[API](https://zapier.com/blog/how-to-use-api/) s, often with your own data


Product features and specialized use cases
